prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the best one for you depends on what you need (SEO, paid ads, branding, B2B lead gen, creative/video), your budget, industry, and whether you want a local or remote partner.

To help you quickly, tell me a few details and I’ll shortlist good matches and explain why:
- What type(s) of marketing do you need? (SEO, PPC/ads, social media, branding, content, email, PR, web design, etc.)
- What’s your monthly or project budget range?
- Are you focused on a particular city/region in Maryland (Baltimore, Annapolis, DC suburbs), or is remote OK?
- Industry (B2B, healthcare, real estate, e‑commerce, nonprofit, etc.) and any must-have experience.
- Timeline and key goals (brand awareness, leads, sales, fundraising).

If you want to evaluate agencies yourself, use this checklist and resources:
- Where to search: Clutch.co, UpCity, Agency Spotter, DesignRush, Google reviews, LinkedIn recommendations.
- Must-check items: relevant case studies, measurable results (traffic, conversions, ROAS), client list/refs, contract length/termination terms, reporting cadence, team bios.
- Interview questions: How will you measure success? Who will be my day-to-day contact? Can you share 2 similar case studies + KPIs? What’s your onboarding process and timeline? What are fees and typical ROI expectations?
- Typical pricing cues: small local agencies often do $2k–8k/month for digital services; full-service or enterprise agencies are $10k+/month or fixed project fees.

If you want, I can:
- Research and send a short ranked list (3–6 agencies) in Maryland tailored to your needs, with a one-line specialty and links to case studies and contact info.
- Or give a recommended interview script and scorecard to compare proposals.

Which would you prefer?
